# Preferences - conceptual responsibility view

The native dialog contains appearance, reading, scrolling, page and browser settings.

Controls below illustrate typed values using today's input widget. They are not a working native dialog or validation binding.
Browser program

Scroll speed
Preferences owns draft validation and persistence; the UI restores live appearance on cancellation.
# Page preview and PDF publication

Export uses a frozen source snapshot, paper profile and font identity.

Preview and PDF reuse layout and typography. Display zoom does not change paper geometry.

Export success does not mark the Markdown document saved.
Concept only: no PDF is written by this prototype.
